Read a simple "count (percent)" table from a PDF page

Source: R/pdftab-simple.R
pdf_read_count_pct_table.Rd

For tables where each row is a single text line: a label followed by one or more count (percent) pairs, ending in a "Total" row. This covers the common case where pdftools::pdf_text() alone preserves row structure because nothing wraps across lines.

Usage

pdf_read_count_pct_table(
  pdf_file,
  page,
  header_pat,
  col_names,
  stop_pat = "^\\s*Total"
)

Arguments

pdf_file

Path to a PDF file.

page

Integer page number.

header_pat

Regular expression identifying the header line; the table body is read starting on the next line.

col_names

Character vector naming the count/percent column pairs, e.g. c("outbreaks", "cases") yields columns outbreaks_n, outbreaks_pct, cases_n, cases_pct.

stop_pat

Regular expression for the row that ends the table (inclusive); defaults to a line starting with "Total".

Value

A data frame with one row per table row (including the Total row), columns label plus <name>_n/<name>_pct for each entry in col_names.
